title: A time zone with a half-hour offset (Kolkata, UTC+05:30)
policy: P14: a record belongs to the local day of its own timestamp.
derivation: 18:10Z Mar 9 = 23:40 IST Mar 9 (1); 18:40Z = 00:10 IST Mar 10 (2); 05:00Z Mar 10 = 10:30 IST (4). Mar 9 = 1, Mar 10 = 6, today 6, week and 30 days 7. Today buckets are whole UTC hours: 18:00Z is 23:30 IST Mar 9, so the 00:10 record lands on Mar 9 (Mar 9 = 3, Mar 10 = 4) and is left out of today (4).
